description: This file implements the ExcelMatch class, providing a static method for the Excel MATCH function. It contains logic for searching for items within an array with different matching strategies, including wildcard handling and compatibility modes.

classes.name: ExcelMatch
classes.description: A class providing static methods to perform the Excel MATCH function, including support for different match types, wildcard comparison, and array evaluations.

methods.name: MATCH
methods.description: Main method to find the position of a lookup value within an array, supporting match types -1, 0, 1, with special handling for arrays and different matching strategies.

methods.name: matchFirstValue
methods.description: Private method to find the first occurrence of a value in an array, with wildcard support if the value is a string.

methods.name: matchLargestValue
methods.description: Private method to find the largest value in an array that is less than or equal to the lookup value, with special handling for strings and numeric values.

methods.name: matchSmallestValue
methods.description: Private method to find the smallest value in an array that is greater than or equal to the lookup value, with wildcard support for string values.

methods.name: validateLookupValue
methods.description: Validates that the lookup value is of a supported type (number, string, boolean).

methods.name: validateMatchType
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the match type parameter to the internal constants.

methods.name: validateLookupArray
methods.description: Checks that the lookup array is not empty.

methods.name: prepareLookupArray
methods.description: Prepares and sanitizes the lookup array, converting strings to lowercase and removing nulls for certain match types.
